class.name: CrashReporter
class.brief_description: Engine singleton for crash dump detection, sidecar launch, and optional in-engine upload.
class.description: [CrashReporter] records native crashes as Breakpad minidumps when the engine is built with [code]crash_reporter=yes[/code] (export templates) or [code]editor_crash_reporter=yes[/code] (editor). Identity is [method get_app_id] plus [method get_build_id] (shared with [Analytics]). Ingest POSTs send [code]X-App-Id[/code] and [code]X-Build-Id[/code]. The editor prints dump paths to the console. Pass [code]--crash-reporter <path>[/code] when launching the editor to spawn a sidecar. Exported games use [member ProjectSettings.application/crash_reporter/reporter_path] with [code]upload_mode[/code] Sidecar or Both. See [method get_resolved_config].

method.name: cancel_upload
method.description: Requests cancellation of an in-progress in-engine upload.

method.name: discard_report
method.description: Deletes the dump, metadata, and state files for [param id].

method.name: get_app_id
method.description: Returns the resolved product id sent with crash metadata and [code]X-App-Id[/code]. Shared with [method Analytics.get_app_id].

method.name: get_app_name
method.description: Returns the resolved product display name.

method.name: get_app_version
method.description: Returns the resolved product version.

method.name: get_build_channel
method.description: Returns the resolved build channel ([code]dev[/code], [code]beta[/code], [code]release[/code], or custom).

method.name: get_build_id
method.description: Returns the resolved build id sent with crash metadata and [code]X-Build-Id[/code]. Shared with [method Analytics.get_build_id].

method.name: get_contact_url
method.description: Returns the resolved contact or bug-tracker URL.

method.name: get_crash_directory
method.description: Returns the directory where [code].dmp[/code] files and sidecar JSON are stored.

method.name: get_endpoint
method.description: Returns the resolved ingest URL.

method.name: get_last_dump_path
method.description: Returns the filesystem path of the most recently written minidump, or an empty string if none exists yet.

method.name: get_pending_reports
method.description: Returns pending crash reports as dictionaries with [code]id[/code], [code]dump_path[/code], [code]metadata[/code], and [code]state[/code].

method.name: get_privacy_policy_url
method.description: Returns the privacy policy URL shown by a custom reporter UI.

method.name: get_reporter_path
method.description: Returns the resolved sidecar reporter executable. In the editor this comes from [code]--crash-reporter[/code]; in exported games it comes from [member ProjectSettings.application/crash_reporter/reporter_path]. Empty when none is configured.

method.name: get_resolved_config
method.description: Returns all resolved crash-reporter settings after environment, bake-in, and Project Settings overrides.

method.name: get_upload_mode
method.description: Returns the resolved upload mode.

method.name: has_pending_reports
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] if unsubmitted dumps exist in the crash directory.

method.name: induce_crash
method.description: Triggers a native access violation so the platform crash handler writes a Breakpad dump. The process does not return. No-op (prints an error) when Breakpad was not compiled in.

method.name: is_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when the [CrashReporter] module is compiled in.

method.name: is_breakpad_enabled
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] when Breakpad dump generation was compiled in ([code]USE_BREAKPAD[/code]).

method.name: is_enabled
method.description: Returns the resolved master switch. When [code]false[/code], dumps may still be written but spawn and upload are skipped.

method.name: is_http_upload_available
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] in export templates built with [code]crash_reporter=yes[/code]. Always [code]false[/code] in the editor.

method.name: is_uploading
method.description: Returns [code]true[/code] while an in-engine upload is running.

method.name: launch_reporter
method.description: Spawns the configured sidecar reporter. In the editor this requires [code]--crash-reporter <path>[/code].

method.name: mark_report_submitted
method.description: Marks [param id] as submitted so it is no longer pending.

method.name: upload_pending
method.description: Uploads all pending reports using the in-engine HTTP client. Call this after the player consents when [member ProjectSettings.application/crash_reporter/require_user_consent] is [code]true[/code].

method.name: upload_report
method.description: Uploads a single pending report by [param id].

method.name: write_minidump
method.description: Writes a minidump without terminating the process. Returns the dump path, or an empty string if Breakpad is not enabled. Also writes/updates the metadata sidecar.

signal.name: upload_failed
signal.description: Emitted when an in-engine upload fails.

signal.name: upload_progress
signal.description: Emitted as an in-engine upload starts sending bytes.

signal.name: upload_started
signal.description: Emitted when an in-engine upload begins.

signal.name: upload_succeeded
signal.description: Emitted when an in-engine upload receives an HTTP 2xx response.

constants.constant: Do not upload or spawn a sidecar.
Upload pending dumps from the game process on the next launch.
Use both in-engine upload and the sidecar reporter.
